subject.title: fix(nextcloud-talk): replay test this-typing breaks tsgo:test on macOS checkouts

question: Should this small macOS developer-typecheck repair be accepted as an exception to the policy against standalone test-only fixes for known main failures?
rationale: Correctness and proof are adequate, but the repository explicitly reserves acceptance of this PR shape to maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the narrow exception
options.body: Land the test-helper portability fix because it restores a supported macOS development lane with no runtime or API impact.

options.title: Enforce contribution routing
options.body: Close this PR under the test-only policy and require the macOS regression to be tracked through an issue or folded into a substantive fix.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow exception
recommendation.body: Land the test-helper portability fix because it restores a supported macOS development lane with no runtime or API impact.

likelyOwner.reason: This is principally a repository contribution-policy exception rather than a Nextcloud Talk product decision.
